messages:
Anya: Quick sync 1 playground stream UX. Users are confused by the single 'Stop' control 1 some expect to be able to 'hold' and resume. Figma: https://fig.ma/file/streaming-ux-v4. Looking for copy, affordance, and a11y input.
Jon: we should split semantics: Hold (preserve state, allow resume) vs Abort (discard). 'Regenerate' stays separate and always starts fresh.
Priya: +1. Suggest UI: inline microchip anchored to the message: [Held  9 buffered] with a secondary "Resume" action. Use a subtle gray and accessible contrast.
Sam: implementation note 1 runtime stores partial KV for 3 minutes by default. If we expose Hold, we need to surface TTL: "Held  expires in 2:59". Also show a small warning if model/version changed.
Anya: good call. On copy, thinking short, plain verbs: Hold / Abort / Regenerate. Tooltip copy candidates: 'Hold: pause and resume later' and 'Abort: stop and clear response'.
Jon: consider long-press on mobile to surface token peek instead of always showing token counts. Desktop hover for token peek: "9 tokens  est $0.0009". But hide by default for non-dev users.
Priya: a11y: token info should be optional under a Developer Mode toggle in Settings. If enabled, token overlay must be keyboard-focusable and announced with aria-describedby.
design-bot: icon guidance: Hold = half-filled pause, Abort = filled stop (danger color), Regenerate = circular arrow. Use different affordance states to avoid accidental taps.
Anya: behavior question: if user hits Regenerate while the message is Held, should Regenerate resume+regenerate or discard and start fresh? Proposal: Regenerate always starts fresh. Add a tooltip on Regenerate when message is Held: "Will discard held data".
Sam: edge case: if user switches model mid-hold, resume should be blocked. Show a tiny inline alert: "Cannot resume: model changed" and provide 'Regenerate on current model' CTA.
Priya: keyboard shortcuts: propose 'H' toggle Hold/Resume (when message focused), 'A' for Abort with confirm, 'G' for Regenerate. Ensure the confirm uses clear copy: "Discard held response and regenerate?"
Anya: microcopy candidates for hold-chip: 'Held  expires in 3:00' and resume label 'Resume response'. For abort confirmation: 'Abort response  this will discard progress'.
design-bot: small layout nit 1 keep token peek anchored to the message toolbar to avoid layout shift. Use a slide-over rather than modal.
aria-bot: accessibility checklist: focus order, announce hold/resume via polite aria-live region, expose keyboard shortcuts in Help, ensure color contrast and visible focus states.
Jon: research note: in interviews, power users liked token peek but casual users found counts distracting. Default to off, opt-in Developer Mode.
Priya: action items: Anya to update Figma with Hold chip + TTL and confirm copy; Sam to add runtime TTL flag and resume-block banner prototype; Jon to write short help center doc for Developer Mode token peek; I'll draft a11y acceptance criteria.
Anya: thanks team  I'll upload the updated mocks by EOD and tag this thread. :rocket:
